description: Declared deploy bundle for GH-Cost Phase 1 GitHub App auth: github_app_token.py (installation-token minter), github_app_cred.sh (git credential wrapper wired via ~/.hermes/gitconfig), and thermal_github_app_probe.py (body-suppressed thermal runner registration probes). github_app_token.py is also refreshed by reconcile_launchd_environment.py on release cut; github_app_cred.sh and thermal_github_app_probe.py previously had no manifest, so mini-release-cut.sh could merge changes while the live mini kept stale/missing copies (same defect class as 86e2hap1g / v0.18.2). This file IS the bundle install_github_app.py copies; nothing outside its files list is written.

coexist_required.reason: github_app_cred.sh and thermal_github_app_probe.py resolve GH App credentials via op-run --env-file; owned outside this bundle, never installed by it

files.role: mints a short-lived GitHub App installation token to stdout; exit 77 = permanent credential failure, 75 = transient; never logs credentials or the minted token
git credential helper for the Hermes Dev Assistant GitHub App; mints a fresh installation token per request via op-run + github_app_token.py; never stores one

body-suppressed GET/POST probes against the thermal repo's runner registration endpoints (owner ignitemarketing post-2026-08-06 transfer, verified against pr_pipeline/hermes-runner-registration.json); emits JSON status codes only, never logs registration tokens or response bodies
